purpose: Before opening the 1,152-candidate identity-flow grid, test its necessary premise: wallet-coin skill estimated strictly from earlier dates must persist in two development partitions and an untouched validation partition. Failure retires the dependency before flow optimization, Bybit replay, risk search or 2026 data.

source_contract.validation_files: UTC hours 12,13,14,15 on 2025-08-05 and 2025-08-06; remain unread until the development gate and placebo pass

parser.keep: crossed=true taker fills with recognized side, finite positive price and size, integer time/tid/oid
parser.episode: wallet-coin signed taker flow aggregated in completed 5-second UTC buckets
parser.market_price: earliest timestamp and median taker-fill price per coin/tid
parser.forward_price: first market trade at or after bucket end plus 60 or 300 seconds, rejected when more than 5 seconds late

causal_score.update_time: At each UTC date boundary, use only resolved episodes from strictly earlier selected dates
causal_score.cohorts: Upper and lower score tails, each max(10,ceil(tail_fraction*eligible_wallets)); candidate-date-coin inactive when tails overlap or fewer than 20 wallets are eligible
causal_score.evaluation_unit: One current-date mean markout per wallet-coin, preventing highly active wallets from dominating by episode count
causal_score.signed_persistence: current markout for upper-tail wallets and negative current markout for lower-tail wallets

each_partition: mean signed persistence greater than zero
upper-minus-lower current markout spread at least 4 bp
mean prior-score/current-markout correlation greater than zero
combined: median signed persistence greater than zero
mean signed persistence remains greater than zero after removing the largest positive 10%
development_gate.placebo: For the selected winner only, 500 fixed-seed activity-matched random upper/lower cohort assignments; true combined mean signed persistence must exceed the 95th percentile of placebo means
development_gate.validation_opening: Validation files remain unread unless every development condition and placebo pass

validation_gate: fixed development winner with no parameter change
both dates and at least two coins represented
mean and median signed persistence greater than zero
mean score/current-markout correlation greater than zero
top-10%-removed mean signed persistence greater than zero
each validation date mean signed persistence greater than zero
promotion: Only a validation pass opens preregistration_v2.json and its 1,152 identity-flow candidates. It does not open 2026, Bybit execution, strategy PnL, risk/leverage optimization, official ranking or orders.
